executive_summary_zh: 今天高信号内容偏少，最值得关注的是 GitHub 对 Copilot 使用度量的扩展：企业现在可以按客户端、模型和选择模式追踪来自 IDE 之外工具链的 AI 编码使用情况。
这类度量改进比单纯的聊天入口或协作集成更重要，因为它直接影响平台团队对 AI 编码工具采用、成本分摊、治理和效果评估的可观测性。
其余候选多为聚合页、轻量产品更新或协作入口改版，技术深度和对后端/平台负责人的可操作价值有限。
executive_summary_en: It’s a weak day overall; the clearest high-signal item is GitHub’s expansion of Copilot usage metrics to cover non-IDE tools, enabling better tracking of AI coding usage across the broader toolchain.

This matters more than chat-entry or collaboration integrations because it improves observability for adoption, chargeback, governance, and effectiveness measurement of AI coding across an enterprise.
Most other candidates are index pages, lightweight product updates, or collaboration UX changes with limited technical depth for backend/platform engineering leads.

items.title: Usage metrics API adds usage from tools like OpenCode - GitHub Changelog
items.summary_zh: GitHub 扩展了 Copilot Usage Metrics API，使企业/组织级 1 天和 28 天报表可以纳入更多非 IDE 客户端的模型调用，包括 OpenCode、claude_code、codex、zed、copilot_cli、github_app、cloud_agent、code_review 等。新增的 totals_by_client 结构按客户端提供请求数、会话数、token 使用量，并支持按模型及 model_selection_mode 进一步拆分。
items.summary_en: GitHub expanded the Copilot Usage Metrics API so 1-day and 28-day enterprise/org reports now include model usage from more non-IDE clients, including OpenCode, claude_code, codex, zed, copilot_cli, github_app, cloud_agent, and code_review. The new totals_by_client structure exposes request counts, session counts, token usage, and breakdowns by model and model_selection_mode.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对平台和工程效率负责人来说，AI 编码已经不再局限于 IDE 插件，而是分散到 CLI、代码审查、云代理和第三方客户端。过去基于 IDE 遥测的统计会低估真实用量，导致预算、治理、许可优化和 ROI 判断失真。这个更新把服务端可归因的请求统一进报表，为跨工具链的采用分析和成本核算提供了基础数据面。
items.why_it_matters_en: For platform and eng productivity leaders, AI coding has spread beyond IDE plugins into CLIs, code review flows, cloud agents, and third-party clients. IDE-only telemetry undercounts real usage, distorting budgeting, governance, license optimization, and ROI analysis. This update adds a server-side attribution layer that makes cross-toolchain adoption and cost accounting more reliable.
key_takeaways_zh: 新增 totals_by_client，可按客户端统计 request_count、session_count、token_usage，并识别 opencode、claude_code、codex、zed 等具体调用来源。
新增按模型和 model_selection_mode 的细分，能区分用户显式选模、自动选模和产品默认选模，为策略治理和成本分析提供更细粒度依据。
覆盖 enterprise、organization、enterprise-user、organization-user 维度的 1 天和 28 天报表，适合做团队、个人和时间窗口上的对比分析。
key_takeaways_en: The new totals_by_client array provides per-client request_count, session_count, and token_usage, with explicit attribution to sources like OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, and Zed.
Breakdowns by model and model_selection_mode distinguish user-selected, auto-selected, and product-selected models, improving governance and cost analysis.
The data is exposed across enterprise, organization, enterprise-user, and organization-user 1-day and 28-day reports, making it usable for team-, user-, and period-level comparisons.

items.title: Turn notifications into code with GitHub Copilot in Teams - GitHub Changelog
items.summary_zh: GitHub 在 Microsoft Teams 的新整合应用中加入 Copilot 能力，允许团队在收到 issue/通知后，通过 @github 直接触发调查、修复并创建 PR。它把通知、会话和仓库上下文连接起来，试图把协作入口转为代码执行入口。
items.summary_en: GitHub added Copilot capabilities to its consolidated Microsoft Teams app, allowing teams to take an issue notification and use @github to investigate, fix, and create a pull request directly from the conversation. It turns notifications and chat context into an execution entry point tied to a repository.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这不是底层技术突破，但它体现了 AI 编码入口从 IDE 向协作工具外溢的趋势。对工程组织而言，值得观察的不是 Teams 本身，而是‘通知 -> agent -> PR’这一闭环是否会改变缺陷分流、值班响应和跨职能协作路径。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is not a deep technical breakthrough, but it does signal the continued shift of AI coding entry points from the IDE into collaboration surfaces. The important pattern is the 'notification -> agent -> PR' loop and whether it changes bug triage, on-call response, and cross-functional workflows.
key_takeaways_zh: GitHub 正在把 Copilot 能力嵌入团队协作界面，而不仅是代码编辑器或 CLI。
该能力面向 issue/通知到修复 PR 的短路径自动化，但目前公开信息更偏工作流描述，缺少权限模型、审计、评测或失败恢复等技术细节。
key_takeaways_en: GitHub is embedding Copilot into team collaboration surfaces, not just editors or CLIs.
The feature targets a short path from issue notification to fix PR, but the public details are workflow-oriented and light on permissioning, auditability, evaluation, and failure-recovery mechanics.

new_terms_zh: totals_by_client：按客户端来源拆分 Copilot 模型调用的报表结构
model_selection_mode：标识模型是用户手选、自动选择还是产品默认选择的字段
new_terms_en: totals_by_client: a reporting structure that breaks Copilot model usage down by calling client
model_selection_mode: a field indicating whether a model was user-selected, auto-selected, or product-selected
themes_zh: AI 编码使用可观测性从 IDE 遥测转向服务端归因
AI 编码入口继续从编辑器扩展到协作与通知系统
themes_en: AI coding observability is shifting from IDE telemetry toward server-side attribution
AI coding entry points continue to expand from editors into collaboration and notification systems
implications_zh: 如果你在企业内同时支持 Cursor/Codex/Claude Code/OpenCode/CLI 等多种入口，现在应重构内部 AI 使用报表，避免继续用 IDE 维度作为主要代理指标。
平台团队可以基于客户端、模型和选模方式建立更精细的成本治理策略，例如限制高成本模型的默认路由、识别高频但低价值客户端，或为特定团队做工具标准化。
协作面集成会增加‘非开发环境触发代码变更’的比例，因此权限边界、审计日志、PR 质量门禁和回滚策略会比入口便利性更重要。
implications_en: If your enterprise supports multiple AI coding entry points such as Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and CLI flows, you should revisit internal reporting and stop treating IDE-based metrics as the primary proxy for adoption.

Platform teams can use client-, model-, and selection-mode-level data to implement finer-grained cost governance, such as constraining default routing to expensive models or identifying high-frequency but low-value clients.

As collaboration-surface integrations increase the share of code changes initiated outside traditional dev environments, permission boundaries, audit logs, PR quality gates, and rollback practices become more important than entry-point convenience.

what_to_ignore_zh: GitHub Changelog 的索引页和月份归档页只是聚合入口，不应作为独立新闻条目收录。
ChatPRD 的界面改版、Cmd+K 操作和文档 @ 引用更偏产品工作流增强，对后端/平台负责人今天的技术信号不足。
仅描述‘把通知变成代码’的营销式工作流，而没有权限、评测、架构或治理细节的内容，应降低优先级。
what_to_ignore_en: The GitHub Changelog index and monthly archive pages are aggregation pages, not standalone items worth including.
ChatPRD’s UI refresh, Cmd+K actions, and document mentions are mostly product workflow enhancements with limited technical signal for backend/platform leaders today.
Marketing-style workflow announcements about turning notifications into code, without details on permissions, evaluation, architecture, or governance, should be deprioritized.
